analysis.title: Skew do Brasil
key_insights: Since Brazil's first-round election, EWZ options flows have turned increasingly defensive, pushing near-term skew to record highs. Election downside fear is getting expensive.
GS trade idea: buy EWZ Jan 15, 2027 45/55 call spreads for around $2.34 (35d, spot $42.77). GS says historical precedent suggests significant room for further upside.
GS says Brazil's presidential runoff has tightened considerably. Flávio Bolsonaro's initial 5-6 point lead has narrowed to roughly 51% versus Lula's 49%, within most polls' margins of error.
The October 23 Globo debate is the final major catalyst ahead of the October 25 vote.
Election uncertainty has pushed VXEWZ towards 65. With the November EWZ $43 straddle around $6, election volatility commands a substantial premium.

GS says selling volatility, including covered calls against existing longs, is one way to express a view that the market is overpricing the eventual move. The stated risk is a major post-election gap.
The divergence between EWZ and the Bloomberg Commodity Index remains unusually wide. Once the political dust settles, that relationship could become more relevant.
